localChanges: Migration-only ES module without UI, network or storage access
Forward conversion only; the supplied reverse conversion and lossy rounding are not exposed
Strict main/map/page/extension/overflow validation instead of empty-data substitution
Wrap-aware uint32 counter ordering and ambiguity rejection
Immutable caller input, selected-slot ownership and raw non-layout/RTC byte preservation
1500 logical records per converted slot and non-box metadata verified after writing
Adopt 0.50.1 forward-writer backup main bank and conditional sector-16 page-zero backup; retain existing L saves byte-for-byte and the separate verified runtime probe correction
Add reviewed W (63-byte) forward layout, move-high-bit relocation and 0x34ff bridge; retain target-specific allocation ownership, strict validation and no downgrade or lossy rounding

Add separately classified 16 MiB physical slot relocation, full-byte conflict checks, unknown-sector preservation and byte-exact relocation verification; retain all earlier record validation and no reverse conversion
Synchronous inspection borrows ordinary input; shared buffers and asynchronous conversion retain private entry snapshots. No input mutation or changed output bytes.
Decode the private slot buffer in place instead of cloning it a second time; 16MiB inspection large-buffer allocations fall from 28MiB to 6MiB.

Add X/SHL4 78-byte forward records from 0.59.2, W egg-block conversion, six supplied versioned keys and strict checksum/MAC rejection; preserve current X bytes and all existing tamper evidence. Unknown destination extents fail closed. Sector transforms use a rolling key pair.

0.59.6: accept native aligned and earlier-tool egg checksums, repair stale W eggs in otherwise-X saves without rewriting other sectors, reject unreadable active egg storage, and recognize the seventh supplied sector key.
